class.name: EditorSearchBar
class.experimental: This editor UI component may change as more editor screens adopt it.
class.brief_description: A standardized editor search field with debounce, result count, and filter actions.
class.description: Combines a clearable search field, optional result count, and action area. Directional key events can be forwarded to a result control so keyboard navigation works while the search field retains focus.

method.name: add_filter_action
method.description: Adds a filter or search-option action to the trailing toolbar.

method.name: clear_query
method.description: Clears [member query] and immediately emits [signal query_changed].

method.name: get_line_edit
method.description: Returns the underlying search [LineEdit] for focus and selection operations.

method.name: set_forward_control
method.description: Forwards directional and page-navigation key events to [param control].

members.member: Delay before [signal query_changed] is emitted while typing. Set to [code]0[/code] for immediate updates.
Placeholder shown while the query is empty.
Displayed result count. A negative value hides the count.

signal.name: query_changed
signal.description: Emitted after the debounce period when the query changes.

signal.name: query_submitted
signal.description: Emitted when the user submits the search field.
